**Glacier Hut Wardens' Association: Register Extract**

**Wardens**
- Tobias Kaufmann, licence code GHW-0987, certified on 2022-08-27, radio callsign Cirque Bravo.
- Elodie Rochat, licence code GHW-0588, certified on 2024-03-16. No radio callsign has been issued to this warden.

**Postings**
- Tobias Kaufmann is auditor at Rifugio Quintino Sella, from 2022-07-01 to 2025-10-12.
- Elodie Rochat is relief at Konkordia Hut, from 2022-01-10, with no end date recorded.
- Annelise Brunner is resident at Konkordia Hut, from 2021-06-15, with no end date recorded.

**Inspections**
1. "Roof anchors corroded at Cabane Rochefort": hut Cabane des Vignettes, inspected on 2025-09-21. Filed by Jakob Imhof, recorded by Marco Delaurenti, countersigned by Annelise Brunner. Follow-up on 2026-01-08. No repair quote was requested.
2. "Stove flue cleared and passing at Hüfi Hut": hut Konkordia Hut, inspected on 2026-01-16. Filed by Jakob Imhof, recorded by Annelise Brunner, countersigned by Tobias Kaufmann. Follow-up on 2026-02-19. Repair quote 96000 cents, JPY.
3. "Emergency radio battery below threshold": hut Gleckstein Hut, inspected on 2026-01-16. Filed by Jakob Imhof, recorded by Annelise Brunner. It awaits countersignature. Follow-up on 2024-12-01. Repair quote 96000 cents, ISK.
4. "Dormitory ladder rung cracked": hut Cabane des Vignettes, inspected on 2025-07-18. Filed by Annelise Brunner, recorded by Tobias Kaufmann. It awaits countersignature. Follow-up on 2026-04-04. Repair quote 310000 cents, PLN.
5. "Lightning earthing intact after storm": hut Rifugio Quintino Sella, inspected on 2024-11-03. Filed by Elodie Rochat, recorded by Annelise Brunner, countersigned by Jakob Imhof. Follow-up on 2026-09-15. Repair quote 508000 cents, NZD.
6. "Fire extinguishers out of date at Tuoi": hut Konkordia Hut, inspected on 2024-12-14. Filed by Marco Delaurenti, recorded by Annelise Brunner, countersigned by Jakob Imhof. Follow-up on 2026-01-08. Repair quote 185000 cents, JPY.
7. "Hut fully compliant, no findings": hut Hörnli Hut, inspected on 2025-01-22. Filed by Tobias Kaufmann, recorded by Annelise Brunner. It awaits countersignature. No revisit is required. Repair quote 19900 cents, HUF.

**Provisions carried up**
- Rye crispbread to Gleckstein Hut: 3.2 jerrycans (unit: jerrycans), cost 4800 cents, CZK, from vendor Lauterbrunnen Mercantile.
- Instant coffee to Cabane de Moiry: 18.0 jerrycans (unit: jerrycans), cost 1990 cents, USD, from vendor Täsch Farm Supply.
